references.text: Samson was captured by the Philistines and put in prison, which explains why he had to be brought from the dungeon to entertain them.
Festive occasions where the heart was glad with wine were common in this culture, as here when the Philistines celebrated.
The expression 'when the heart was merry with wine' is also used about King Nabal, showing a common phrase for drunkenness in ancient Israel.
Absalom waited until Amnon's heart was glad with wine before he acted, a similar pattern of vulnerability under intoxication.
Joseph was also put in prison, thematically parallel to Samson's captivity.
The book of Hebrews mentions heroes of faith who were mocked and imprisoned, which includes Samson's experience.
